status: local proposal; native/full-schema CI pending; not canonical or hosted
behavior: Add restrictive UPDATE USING/WITH CHECK and DELETE USING boundaries for anon/authenticated student-document storage, so broad permissive policies cannot reopen replacement/deletion.
Preserve current upload/read policies and their access/partner restrictions. Block moving objects both out of and into the protected bucket. Other buckets retain their own permissions.
Preserve trusted BYPASSRLS service maintenance; no Storage API call, real file operation or direct metadata cleanup is executed.
Missing canonical upload policy or disabled RLS aborts installation atomically. No stored row is modified.

validation.fixture_correction: Canonical storage read helper must be installed before storage policies; initial setup failures corrected before passing run.

sources.use: Supabase documents that upsert needs SELECT and UPDATE permissions.
Storage owner metadata is not ownership enforcement by itself. No ownership claim is made here.

limits: Minimal storage metadata fixture is not a running Storage API or object store; actual upsert/move/delete HTTP behavior remains untested.
No actual uploader ownership proof or immutable trusted-service byte version; current read exceptions remain separately open.
No durable attempt/content reservation, hard-delete tombstone or exact orphan cleanup.
No guarantee that a service-generated scan result corresponds to immutable reviewed bytes.
